title: Legacy .ppt slides blank in a hidden/occluded window
cause: Slides were built only from IntersectionObserver callbacks; the harness counted 'ready' as a pass
fix: Geometry-based visibility fallback like pdf.ts (fp-legacy); harness now requires visible content for 'ready'

title: RTF character colour and size ignored (red 14pt text shown black)
fix: Colour table and font size per run (fp-legacy)

title: Legacy .ppt subtitle colour differs from the .pptx
Korean run in a .ppt title smaller and not bold
cause: East Asian run formatting not inherited

title: Slide frames differ between .pptx and .ppt
cause: Two renderers with separate frame styles
fix: One frame style: shadow, no double border, same number badge (fp-office, fp-legacy)

title: DOCX reading mode: tight table cells, headings flush on content, list indent, large gap at page breaks
cause: Reading-mode CSS drops cell margins and paragraph spacing; page break rendered as a spacer

title: Tinted theme colours too dark (subtitle #404040 instead of #898989)
cause: Tint applied in RGB instead of PowerPoint's HSL luminance formula

title: Shape labels cross the shape outline (chevron, triangle)
cause: Text placed in the bounding box, not the preset's text rectangle

title: Formula indicator marks poke past cell borders
Page box shows 2/3 when the first page is at the top
cause: Current page picked by the most visible page
fix: Page whose top is nearest the viewport top (fp-media)

title: Black SVG text unreadable on the dark checkerboard
cause: Transparency background follows the dark theme only

title: Error cards show developer text ('PreviewError: cfb · 35 B')
fix: Moved into a collapsed Details element; consistent error codes

title: Toolbar file info cut off with … on phones
fix: Info gets its own wrapping row on phones

title: Orca editor captures show the loading state for slow renderers; verify left sample tabs open
cause: plugin shot mounts a fresh frame and captures at first paint
fix: plugin shot used as a mount/error check; finished renders captured from a few real open tabs (window capture, cropped)

title: Harness passed previews that were blank
cause: 'ready' state alone counted as a pass
fix: Harness requires visible text/image/canvas in the first viewport

title: A damaged (bit-flipped) .xlsx freezes the preview for about 60 s
cause: SheetJS parses on the main thread and loops on corrupted input (found by the fuzz pass)
fix: Parse in a time-limited Web Worker; friendly error on timeout (fp-office)

title: Fuzz run stalled on a frozen page
cause: In-page checks had no timeout; same-origin pages share a renderer process
fix: Harness records 'did not settle' and continues in a fresh browser context
